WorldLevelExplainCfg.Content:
【认知等级与调查等级】
调查等级达到15时，需要完成认知等级突破任务，提升至下一认知等级。
此后每提升5调查等级，认知等级就会提升1级。
此外调查等级达到#ce6550e25#z,#ce6550e35#z,#ce6550e45#z,#ce6550e55#z时，需要完成认知等级突破任务，才可以提升至下一等级。
调查等级最多提升至60；认知等级至多提升至10。

【认知等级调整】
可以往下调整至多1级认知等级。
认知等级降低后，城市里的敌人的等级会随之下降，但获得的奖励也会减少。
认知等级调整后的#ce6550e24小时内#z，无法再次调整。
无论是降低认知等级后恢复至原本等级，还是恢复后仍想降低认知等级，都需等待24小时。

YueKaCfg.Content: 【Monthly Supply Details】 Each Monthly Supply purchase grants #IHud#z Cosmix,  City Currency and #IHud30#z days of service. #rWhile service is active, you can log in daily to claim #IHud#z Jillion Vouchers and  City Currency. (Updates daily at 4:00 AM\【UTC+8\】) #r【Notes】 1. Renewals only extend service when the remaining Monthly Supply time is less than or equal to #IHud180#z days. #r2. If the remaining Monthly Supply time is more than #IHud180#z days, further purchases are not allowed. If a duplicate purchase occurs due to special circumstances, the total service time will not stack and #IHud330#z Cosmix will be refunded. #r3. During the Monthly Supply service period, Jillion Vouchers and City Currency which are not claimed due to missed logins will not be restored.
YueKaCfg.Title: Monthly Supply — Service Details

ShiLingTiXingCfg.Content:
【适龄提示】
1.本游戏是一款动作角色扮演手机游戏，适用于年满16周岁及以上的用户，建议未成年人在家长监护下使用游戏产品。我们鼓励家长根据未成年人的实际情况管理其游戏行为，家长可以关注“网易家长关爱平台”微信公众号、拨打官方客服电话95163611或者登录网易家长关爱平台（https://jiazhang.gm.163.com/convoy/）查看具体指引。

2.本游戏设置了主线、支线剧情，玩家可以通过对话、交互玩法推动剧情，游戏还提供了基于都市题材开放世界的探索玩法。游戏内提供了少量基于文字的陌生人社交系统，该社交系统遵循相关法律法规进行管理。

3.本游戏中有用户实名认证系统，未实名账号不能登录游戏。认证为未成年人的用户将接受以下管理：
游戏中部分玩法和道具需要付费。未满8周岁的用户不能充值；8周岁以上未满16周岁的未成年人用户，单次充值金额不得超过50元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过200元人民币；16周岁以上的未成年人用户，单次充值金额不得超过100元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过400元人民币。
游戏仅会在周五、周六、周日和法定节假日的20时至21时，向未成年人提供1小时游戏服务。

4.游戏基于架空都市世界展开剧情，采用风格鲜明的美术设计、精美的游戏画面以及优质的游戏配乐，为玩家带来积极愉悦的情绪体验。

RandomEventCfg.Content:
We call criminal activities involving Chaos “Skirmishes”, including Chaos gatherings, parties, raids, or brawls.
Agents will gain info on Skirmishes nearby, and locations will be marked on your map. Please investigate and address them promptly.
Skirmishes will inevitably lead to battles, so please be prepared.

HeatGainExplainCfg.Content:
【Buzz Score】
Your Buzz Score is a numerical figure, generated by your recent activities, which gauges your popularity. You can increase your Buzz Score through gameplay. Raising your Buzz Score not only grants you additional fans, but can also be converted into Scope Coins.
Maximum Buzz Score: 1000.

【Fan Count】
Your Fan Count represents the amount of attention you’ve attracted. Increasing your Buzz Score can also increase your Fan Count.

【Scope Coins】
Scope Coins are the reward-based currency tied to Buzz Score. They can be earned through gameplay or by being converted from your Buzz Score. Scope Coins can be exchanged for local currency at the Buzz Center.
HeatGainExplainCfg.Title: System Overview

SexTransitionRuleCfg.Content:
【账号角色数据】
转换形象后，角色模型、配音及动作等资源将同步适配。已解锁的剧情进度、粉丝数及好感度等级将完整继承。
【战斗数据】
角色等级与各类徽章等均予以保留。
【系统数据】
叭叭、叭卜、角色系统界面中涉及的称谓、视觉效果等将根据新形象自动更迭。
SexTransitionRuleCfg.Title: Appearance transformation rules

RankExplainCfg.Content:
【Leaderboard】

The Leaderboard is a public rankings board that tracks and showcases scores across all online game modes. Compete with other players here and climb the rankings.

Server-Wide Leaderboard
· Rankings are displayed by season. Rankings reset at the start of each new season.

Regional Leaderboard
· Players can compete in any region. Your first selection takes effect immediately; subsequent changes will take effect automatically at 4:00 AM the following Monday.
· Rankings are locked and published every Monday at midnight. The top 100 players on both the Server-Wide and Regional Leaderboards receive exclusive badges.

Friends Leaderboard
· Shows you and your friends’ rankings across all game modes.
RankExplainCfg.Title: 排行榜说明

OnlineAppExplainCfg.Content:
【Solo Mode】
Enjoy an immersive solo experience. You will not encounter other players in this mode.

【Public Online】
Explore the world together with others. You will encounter random players from around the world in this mode.

【Private Online】
Have fun with friends. You can invite friends or other players to join by inputting their IDs.
OnlineAppExplainCfg.Title: Game Mode
